title: Content plan - Inés (Spanish, psychologist) - 2026-11-23
summary: Inés should build a warm, personal, expert voice speaking directly to the reader in tú, using short validating statements, permission-giving closers and a few reflective questions that invite replies, while avoiding diagnoses, judgement and pure quote reposts. Her distinct territory (breakups, boundaries, recognising manipulation, self-blame relief) is under-served by competitors, who are either wellbeing generalists, dating-bait accounts or quote-driven. The plan rotates four pillars across 28 posts, with 3 daily slots (soft morning, practical daytime, main evening post) and hypotheses tested across the schedule.

pillars.name: Permiso y autocompasión
pillars.why: Permission and reassurance statements dominate the top performers: 'Te pasó porque había algo malo en esa persona, no en ti' (2086 eng, 125k views) and 'Tranquila' closers, with the 'you' address lifting median engagement to 1344 vs 664.

pillars.name: Relaciones y señales de alarma
pillars.why: Practical red-flag and relationship-quality posts ('Sé exigente porque:', 'Red flag 🚩:') earn high engagement and match Inés's expert niche that no competitor covers well.

pillars.name: Ruptura, exes y límites
pillars.why: Breakups, leaving and boundaries are her core topics and drove the 1.2K-like 'you can leave' theme; competitors like @dr.rodrigoarteaga and @psicologiaconb avoid them entirely, leaving the space open.

pillars.name: Amistad y vínculos propios
pillars.why: Friendship and self-connection extend the reach of warm statements ('Deja que la gente te muestre quién es', 'Aprende a disfrutar de tu propia compañía' at 58k views) into lower-competition territory.

actions.title: Use tú and a direct payoff in most posts
actions.why: Posts with 'you' address have median engagement 1344 vs 664 without (@esmipsicologa); @psico.maxi and @enric_corbera show the same lift (76 vs 59, 42 vs 9).
actions.how: Write at least 2 of every 3 posts addressing the reader as tú, ending with a reassuring line ('Puedes irte.', 'Tranquila.').

actions.title: Adopt a colon hook plus payoff format
actions.why: 'Sé exigente porque:' and 'Red flag 🚩:' are concrete recognisable formats from @esmipsicologa's top posts.
actions.how: Open with a short colon-led hook ('Señales de que...:') and deliver three crisp lines underneath.

actions.title: Ask one easy reflective question per week
actions.why: @enric_corbera's 'hook question' post got 9 replies vs 0-2 for most posts, while generic '¿Qué piensas?' questions on @psico.maxi got 0-5 replies, so the question must be personal and specific.
actions.how: Pose one personal, answerable question in the evening slot ('¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien?') and reply to every comment.

actions.title: Build a personal 'yo' bridge into one post in three
actions.why: The 'yo' bridge model (1184 likes) suits Inés's warm personal brand, though competitor data on 'I' voice is inconclusive and conflicting.
actions.how: Start one post per day with a short first-person observation ('Algo que me ha cambiado la vida:...') that leads into a tú sentence.

actions.title: Credit quotes and add one line of your own
actions.why: Four of @esmipsicologa's top posts are quotes, but the report cannot attribute the success to the account, so quotes should be used sparingly and credited.
actions.how: Use at most 2 quote posts in the plan, always with ' - Name' and one original line above.

actions.title: Keep posts under 200 characters and front-load the hook
actions.why: Short and mid-length posts perform the same (840 vs 895), and @ju_zeppa's sub-100-character prompts drew 161 replies.
actions.how: Write the core idea in 1-2 sentences and place the key message in the first line.

actions.title: Avoid diagnostic labels and harsh judgement
actions.why: Competitor posts with harsh labels ('malísima persona', 'hay personas que...' attacks) conflict with the warm, wellbeing-safe brand, and clinical claims create compliance risk.
actions.how: Describe behaviours ('Te pide que no cuentes lo que pasa') instead of labelling people ('narcisista', 'psicópata').

actions.title: Reply warmly and specifically to painful comments
actions.why: @psicologiaconb's top comments ('Necesitaba este mensaje en mi vida') show people respond to messages arriving at the moment of need, and @ju_zeppa's thin replies erode trust.
actions.how: Answer each emotional comment with one specific, warm sentence, and use light humour only for light comments.

actions.title: Avoid untranslated English and Latin American forms
actions.why: English quotes perform worst (27 likes) and Latin American slang conflicts with the Spain Spanish audience.
actions.how: Keep all copy in Spain Spanish with tú and vosotros forms used consistently.

posts.topic: Lo que te pasó no fue culpa tuya
posts.hook: Lo que te pasó no lo provocaste tú.
posts.draft: Lo que te pasó no lo provocaste tú. Pasó porque alguien decidió hacértelo, no porque tú fueras "demasiado". Tranquila.
posts.hook_en: What happened to you was not your doing.
posts.draft_en: What happened to you was not your doing. It happened because someone chose to do it to you, not because you were "too much." Relax.
posts.tests: self-blame relief statement drives morning engagement
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Te pasó porque había algo malo en esa persona, no en ti.'
posts.why: A short soft morning statement that validates without blame, matching the top-performing reassurance pattern.

posts.topic: Señales de que te piden silencio
posts.hook: Red flag 🚩: te pide que no cuentes lo que pasa entre los dos.
posts.draft:
Red flag 🚩: te pide que no cuentes lo que pasa entre los dos "para no preocupar a nadie".
Otra señal: te hace sentir culpable cuando quedas con tus amigas.
Si te pasa, no es amor, es control.
posts.hook_en: Red flag: he asks you not to tell anyone what happens between you two.
posts.draft_en:
Red flag: he asks you not to tell anyone what happens between you two "so no one worries."
Another sign: he makes you feel guilty when you go out with your friends.
If this happens to you, it is not love, it is control.
posts.tests: specific red-flag format earns recognition
posts.why: Practical daytime list with concrete recognisable signs, the format that earned 1.5K likes.

posts.topic: Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz
posts.hook: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien?
posts.draft:
¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien?
No hace falta que sea una pareja. Puede ser una amiga, tu madre o tú misma.
Cuéntamelo si te apetece. Te leo.
posts.hook_en: When was the last time you felt at peace next to someone?
posts.draft_en:
When was the last time you felt at peace next to someone?
It doesn't have to be a partner. It can be a friend, your mother or yourself.
Tell me if you feel like it. I'll read it.
posts.cta: Invita a responder con una frase en comentarios
posts.tests: a single personal question in the evening slot raises replies
posts.inspiration: @enric_corbera - hook question as first line (9 replies)
posts.why: The evening main post asks one easy personal question that invites replies.

posts.hook: No estás obligada a explicar por qué te vas.
posts.draft: No estás obligada a quedarte donde no te cuidan. Y tampoco a explicar por qué te vas. Puedes irte.
posts.hook_en: You are not obliged to explain why you are leaving.
posts.draft_en: You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for. And you don't have to explain why you're leaving. You can go.
posts.tests: permission to leave drives morning soft post
posts.why: A soft morning permission statement grounded in the most-shared 'you can leave' theme.

posts.topic: Sé exigente: lo que pide una buena pareja
posts.hook: Sé exigente porque:
posts.draft:
Sé exigente porque:
Sus valores criarán a tus hijos.
Su lealtad te respetará cuando no estés delante.
Su bondad cuidará tu vulnerabilidad.
Y su forma de resolver problemas marcará cada dificultad que viváis.
posts.hook_en: Be demanding, because:
posts.draft_en:
Be demanding, because:
His values will shape your children.
His loyalty will respect you when you're not there.
His kindness will look after your vulnerability.
And how he solves problems will shape every difficulty you face together.
posts.tests: colon hook plus payoff lists outperform plain statements
posts.why: Adapts the proven 'Sé exigente porque:' colon-payoff structure into a practical afternoon list.

posts.hook: Cómo te comportaste en modo supervivencia no define quién eres.
posts.draft: Cómo te comportaste cuando estabas en modo supervivencia no define cómo eres en realidad. Tranquila. Lo que hiciste entonces fue sobrevivir.
posts.hook_en: How you behaved in survival mode does not define who you are.
posts.draft_en: How you behaved while you were in survival mode does not define who you really are. Relax. What you did back then was survive.
posts.cta: Pregunta suave: ¿qué te ayudó a salir de ahí?
posts.tests: self-compassion closer after a breakup
posts.why: Self-compassion statement on breakup survival that rewards the reader with a soft closing word.

posts.topic: Hay personas que te quieren como eres
posts.hook: Deja que la gente te muestre quién es.
posts.draft: Deja que la gente te muestre quién es. Y cree lo que hace más que lo que promete. Tú no tienes que adivinarlo.
posts.hook_en: Let people show you who they are.
posts.draft_en: Let people show you who they are. And believe what they do more than what they promise. You don't have to guess it.
posts.tests: short quotable statement without attribution
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Deja que la gente te muestre quién es.' (2136 eng)
posts.why: Adapts a top quotable statement into Inés's own words, keeping it short for a soft morning slot.

posts.hook: Así se nota que alguien te manipula:
posts.draft:
Así se nota que alguien te manipula:
Te hace dudar de lo que recuerdas.
Te pide explicaciones por cosas que no hiciste.
Te dice que nadie más te entiende como él.
Si reconoces alguna, no estás loca. Estás viendo con claridad.
posts.hook_en: This is how you notice someone is manipulating you:
posts.draft_en:
This is how you notice someone is manipulating you:
They make you doubt what you remember.
They ask you to explain things you didn't do.
They tell you nobody understands you like they do.
If you recognise any, you're not crazy. You're seeing clearly.
posts.tests: concrete recognisable signs in a practical list
posts.why: Practical daytime list on manipulation signs, a core topic no competitor covers well.

posts.hook: ¿Quién es la persona que te hace sentir tranquila sin esfuerzo?
posts.draft:
¿Quién es la persona que te hace sentir tranquila sin esfuerzo?
A veces no es la pareja. Es una amiga que te escucha sin juzgar.
Te leo en comentarios. Cuéntame quién es la tuya.
posts.hook_en: Who is the person who makes you feel calm without effort?
posts.draft_en:
Who is the person who makes you feel calm without effort?
Sometimes it is not the partner. It is a friend who listens without judging.
I'll read your comments. Tell me who yours is.
posts.cta: Invita a nombrar una amiga en comentarios
posts.tests: friendship question drives replies in the evening slot
posts.why: Evening question on friendship that is easy to answer and invites personal replies.

posts.hook: Aún no has conocido a todas las personas que te harán feliz.
posts.draft: Tengo una buena noticia para ti: aún no has conocido a todas las personas que te harán feliz ✨ Te quedan muchas personas preciosas por conocer.
posts.hook_en: I have good news for you: you haven't met all the people who will make you happy yet.
posts.draft_en: I have good news for you: you haven't met all the people who will make you happy yet ✨ There are still many wonderful people to meet.
posts.tests: hopeful closing statement after a loss
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Aún no has conocido a todas las personas' (3600 eng)
posts.why: Soft hopeful statement for the morning slot, adapting a top-engaging reassurance post.

posts.hook: Tres límites que puedes poner hoy, sin explicar nada:
posts.draft:
Tres límites que puedes poner hoy, sin explicar nada:
No contestar al mensaje a las 2 de la mañana.
Decir "ahora no puedo" y colgar.
No hablar de tu ex delante de tu nueva pareja.
Poner un límite no es un castigo. Es cuidarte.
posts.hook_en: Three boundaries you can set today, without explaining anything:
posts.draft_en:
Three boundaries you can set today, without explaining anything:
Don't answer the 2 a.m. message.
Say "I can't right now" and hang up.
Don't talk about your ex in front of your new partner.
Setting a boundary is not a punishment. It is looking after yourself.
posts.tests: concrete tip list on boundaries in the daytime slot
posts.why: Practical daytime tips on boundaries, the expert niche with actionable content.

posts.hook: ¿Qué te cuesta más: decir que no o que te entiendan?
posts.draft:
¿Qué te cuesta más: decir que no o que te entiendan?
A mí, durante mucho tiempo, las dos cosas. Aprender a no explicarlo todo me cambió.
Cuéntame cuál es la tuya en comentarios.
posts.hook_en: What is harder for you: saying no or being understood?
posts.draft_en:
What is harder for you: saying no or being understood?
For me, for a long time, both. Learning not to explain everything changed me.
Tell me yours in the comments.
posts.cta: Pide que nombren la dificultad en comentarios
posts.tests: 'yo' bridge into a personal question
posts.why: Evening post using the personal 'yo' bridge leading into a question that invites replies.

posts.hook: Querer a alguien también es trabajarte tú.
posts.draft: Querer a una persona también es trabajarte tú para no hacerle daño a ella. Y para no hacértelo a ti. Eso también es amor.
posts.hook_en: Loving someone also means working on yourself.
posts.draft_en: Loving someone also means working on yourself so you don't hurt them. And so you don't hurt yourself. That is love too.
posts.tests: reflective statement about self-work in relationships
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - 'Querer a una persona también es trabajarte TÚ' (2689 eng)
posts.why: Soft morning reflection adapting a high-performing statement on relationships.

posts.topic: Señales de que es hora de irte
posts.hook: Señales de que es hora de irte:
posts.draft:
Señales de que es hora de irte:
Te sientes sola aunque estéis juntos.
Te pides perdón por cosas que no hiciste.
Te da miedo su reacción cuando dices que no.
No tienes que tener un motivo perfecto para irte.
posts.hook_en: Signs it's time to leave:
posts.draft_en:
Signs it's time to leave:
You feel alone even when you're together.
You apologise for things you didn't do.
You're afraid of his reaction when you say no.
You don't need a perfect reason to leave.
posts.tests: practical signs list on leaving
posts.why: Daytime list on when to leave, building on the most-shared 'you can leave' theme.

posts.hook: ¿Te has permitido cambiar de opinión sobre alguien?
posts.draft:
¿Te has permitido cambiar de opinión sobre alguien?
No pasa nada si te diste cuenta tarde. Lo importante es que ahora lo ves.
Te leo si quieres contarlo.
posts.hook_en: Have you allowed yourself to change your mind about someone?
posts.draft_en:
Have you allowed yourself to change your mind about someone?
It's fine if you realised late. What matters is that you see it now.
I'll read it if you want to share.
posts.cta: Pide que compartan una vez que cambiaron de opinión
posts.tests: reassuring question in the evening slot
posts.why: Evening question combining reassurance with an easy-to-answer prompt.

posts.hook: Aprende a disfrutar de tu propia compañía.
posts.draft: Aprende a disfrutar de tu propia compañía. Toma tu café sin prisa. Sal a caminar. Haz planes contigo misma, aunque nadie te acompañe.
posts.hook_en: Learn to enjoy your own company.
posts.draft_en: Learn to enjoy your own company. Have your coffee without rushing. Go for a walk. Make plans with yourself, even if nobody joins you.
posts.tests: solo-life statement lifts reach
posts.inspiration: @dr.rodrigoarteaga - 'Aprende a disfrutar de tu propia compañía' (58k views)
posts.why: Soft morning statement on solitude that drew the highest reach in the competitor set.

posts.topic: Lo que sí es una buena pareja
posts.hook: Una buena pareja se nota en cosas pequeñas:
posts.draft:
Una buena pareja se nota en cosas pequeñas:
Cumple lo que dice.
Se alegra de tus logros sin sentirse amenazada.
Habla de los problemas en vez de castigarte con silencios.
Lo pequeño también dice mucho.
posts.hook_en: A good partner shows in small things:
posts.draft_en:
A good partner shows in small things:
They do what they say.
They are happy for your achievements without feeling threatened.
They talk about problems instead of punishing you with silence.
The small things say a lot too.
posts.tests: positive-signs list complements red-flag list
posts.why: Afternoon list of positive signs, balancing the red-flag content.

posts.hook: ¿Cuántas veces has repasado la misma conversación en tu cabeza?
posts.draft:
¿Cuántas veces has repasado la misma conversación en tu cabeza?
Revisar el final no lo cambia. Te devuelve a un lugar que ya no existe.
Cuéntame cuántas veces te pasa a la semana en comentarios.
posts.hook_en: How many times have you replayed the same conversation in your head?
posts.draft_en:
How many times have you replayed the same conversation in your head?
Reviewing the ending doesn't change it. It takes you back to a place that no longer exists.
Tell me how often it happens to you each week in the comments.
posts.cta: Pide que digan cuántas veces a la semana
posts.tests: question on ruminating after a breakup invites replies
posts.inspiration: @psico.maxi - 'Soltar ese «¿y si…?»' theme, with a personal question
posts.why: Evening question on rumination after a breakup, tested for reply rate.

posts.hook: Cuando no estés bien, date un respiro.
posts.draft: Cuando tu cabeza no esté del todo bien, date un respiro. No te sientas culpable por hacer menos. Estás haciendo lo mejor que puedes.
posts.hook_en: When you're not doing well, give yourself a break.
posts.draft_en: When your mind isn't completely okay, give yourself a break. Don't feel guilty for doing less. You're doing the best you can.
posts.tests: autocompassion message in the Sunday morning slot
posts.why: Gentle Sunday morning permission message, the top-engaging post on @psicologiaconb.

posts.hook: Las mentiras pequeñas también hacen daño:
posts.draft:
Las mentiras pequeñas también hacen daño:
"Llego en diez minutos" y tarda dos horas.
"No pasa nada" cuando pasa todo.
"Eres tú el que lo recuerda mal".
Detectarlas no es desconfiar. Es escucharte.
posts.hook_en: Small lies also do damage:
posts.draft_en:
Small lies also do damage:
"I'll be there in ten minutes" and it takes two hours.
"Nothing's wrong" when everything is.
"You're the one who remembers it wrong."
Noticing them is not distrust. It is listening to yourself.
posts.tests: concrete everyday examples of manipulation
posts.why: Sunday afternoon list with concrete everyday examples, avoiding diagnostic labels.

posts.hook: ¿Quién te escucha sin juzgar cuando lo necesitas?
posts.draft:
¿Quién te escucha sin juzgar cuando lo necesitas?
Yo aprendí a valorar a esas personas tarde. Ahora las busco.
Cuéntame quién es la tuya.
posts.hook_en: Who listens to you without judging when you need it?
posts.draft_en:
Who listens to you without judging when you need it?
I learned to value those people late. Now I look for them.
Tell me who yours is.
posts.cta: Invita a nombrar a una persona
posts.tests: friendship question closing the Sunday evening
posts.why: Sunday evening question on friendship, a warm closing prompt for replies.

posts.topic: Tu historia no empieza con él
posts.hook: Tu vida no empezó cuando llegó esa persona.
posts.draft: Tu vida no empezó cuando llegó esa persona. Ya tenías tu risa, tus gustos y tu forma de querer. Eso sigue ahí.
posts.hook_en: Your life didn't start when that person arrived.
posts.draft_en: Your life didn't start when that person arrived. You already had your laugh, your tastes and your way of loving. That is still there.
posts.tests: identity-restoring statement after a relationship
posts.why: Soft Monday morning statement restoring identity after a relationship.

posts.hook: Cómo sostener un no sin pedir perdón:
posts.draft:
Cómo sostener un no sin pedir perdón:
Dilo corto: "No, gracias".
No lo justifiques con mil razones.
Si insisten, repite lo mismo con calma.
Un no no necesita defensa.
posts.hook_en: How to hold a no without apologising:
posts.draft_en:
How to hold a no without apologising:
Say it short: "No, thank you."
Don't justify it with a thousand reasons.
If they push, repeat the same thing calmly.
A no doesn't need defending.
posts.tests: practical boundary tip list
posts.why: Afternoon practical tip on holding boundaries, the expert core of the account.

posts.hook: ¿Qué querías de verdad en esa relación y no te dieron?
posts.draft:
¿Qué querías de verdad en esa relación y no te dieron?
Nombrarlo ayuda a no buscarlo otra vez en la persona equivocada.
Te leo en comentarios.
posts.hook_en: What did you truly want from that relationship and never got?
posts.draft_en:
What did you truly want from that relationship and never got?
Naming it helps you stop looking for it in the wrong person again.
I'll read it in the comments.
posts.cta: Invita a responder con una palabra
posts.tests: naming unmet needs drives replies
posts.why: Evening question on unmet needs, tested as a reflective invitation to reply.

posts.hook: Algunos miedos parecen enormes, hasta que los miras de cerca.
posts.draft: Algunos miedos parecen enormes. Rascas un poco y empiezan a desinflarse. Primero a salvo. Y si vuelves a encontrarte con ellos, recuerda quién eres hoy.
posts.hook_en: Some fears seem enormous, until you look at them closely.
posts.draft_en: Some fears seem enormous. Scratch a little and they start to deflate. First, get safe. And if you meet them again, remember who you are today.
posts.tests: gentle fear reassurance in a morning slot
posts.why: Soft Tuesday morning reassurance adapting a strong-reach statement.

posts.topic: Cómo sabes que es amor sano
posts.hook: El amor sano se nota en cinco cosas:
posts.draft:
El amor sano se nota en cinco cosas:
Se puede hablar de lo que duele.
No te obliga a elegir entre él y tus amigas.
Respeta tus tiempos.
Te deja ser tú.
Y después de discutir, se repara.
posts.hook_en: Healthy love shows in five things:
posts.draft_en:
Healthy love shows in five things:
You can talk about what hurts.
It doesn't make you choose between him and your friends.
It respects your time.
It lets you be yourself.
And after an argument, it repairs.
posts.tests: positive-signs list format on healthy love
posts.why: Afternoon positive-signs list, the practical counterpart to red flags.

posts.topic: No necesitas la aprobación de nadie para irte
posts.hook: No necesitas la aprobación de nadie para irte de una relación.
posts.draft: No necesitas la aprobación de nadie para irte de una relación que te hace daño. Ni de tu familia, ni de tus amigas, ni del que se queda. Irte también es cuidarte.
posts.hook_en: You don't need anyone's approval to leave a relationship.
posts.draft_en: You don't need anyone's approval to leave a relationship that hurts you. Not your family, not your friends, not the one who stays. Leaving is also looking after yourself.
posts.tests: permission-to-leave statement as the main Tuesday post
posts.why: Main Tuesday evening post on leaving, the strongest-performing theme.

posts.hook: ¿Hay alguna amistad que necesitas cuidar más esta semana?
posts.draft:
¿Hay alguna amistad que necesitas cuidar más esta semana?
A veces una llamada sencilla lo cambia todo.
Cuéntame en comentarios y te leo.
posts.hook_en: Is there a friendship you need to look after more this week?
posts.draft_en:
Is there a friendship you need to look after more this week?
Sometimes a simple phone call changes everything.
Tell me in the comments and I'll read them.
posts.cta: Invita a nombrar una amistad en comentarios
posts.tests: closing friendship question as the week's last main post
posts.inspiration: @enric_corbera - reflective question closing a reflective post
posts.why: Closing Wednesday evening question that invites replies and extends the friendship pillar.

posts.hook: Señales de que alguien te manipula, aunque no lo parezca:
posts.draft:
Señales de que alguien te manipula, aunque no lo parezca:

- Te hace dudar de lo que recuerdas.
- Te pide que no cuentes lo que pasa "para no preocupar a nadie".
- Cada conflicto acaba con que tú pides perdón.

No es un diagnóstico, solo una pista. ¿Cuál te suena?
posts.hook_en: Signs someone is manipulating you, even if it doesn't look like it:
posts.draft_en:
Signs someone is manipulating you, even if it doesn't look like it:

- They make you doubt what you remember.
- They ask you not to tell anyone "so no one worries."
- Every conflict ends with you apologising.

It's not a diagnosis, just a clue. Which one sounds familiar?
posts.cta: Pregunta: ¿cuál de estas señales te suena?
posts.tests: Red flag format with a recognisable concrete example
posts.why: A practical list of recognisable signs gives a clear daytime tip that invites recognition.

posts.hook: Durante años creí que tenía que explicar cada decisión para tener derecho a tomarla.
posts.draft:
Durante años creí que tenía que explicar cada decisión para tener derecho a tomarla. Irme de una relación, decir que no, cerrar una puerta.

Hoy sé que no estás obligada a justificarte para cuidarte. ¿A ti te pasa lo mismo?
posts.hook_en: For years I believed I had to explain every decision to have the right to make it.
posts.draft_en:
For years I believed I had to explain every decision to have the right to make it. Leaving a relationship, saying no, closing a door.

Today I know you don't have to justify yourself to take care of yourself. Does this happen to you too?
posts.cta: Pregunta: ¿a ti te pasa lo mismo?
posts.tests: 'I' voice as a bridge to 'you' (personal story with a reflective question)
posts.inspiration: @enric_corbera - reflective question closing a relatable statement; @ju_zeppa - personal story with an ask
posts.why: A first-person bridge to a 'you' question invites replies on an under-served boundary topic.

posts.hook: Hoy no tienes que estar bien. Solo tienes que estar.
posts.draft: Hoy no tienes que estar bien. Solo tienes que estar. Tranquila, sin exigirte más de lo que puedes.
posts.hook_en: Today you don't have to be okay. You just have to be.
posts.draft_en: Today you don't have to be okay. You just have to be. Easy does it, without asking more of yourself than you can give.
posts.tests: Short soft morning line with a permission-giving closer
posts.inspiration: @psicologiaconb - permission-giving, soft message that hit a need
posts.why: A short validating morning line matches the highest-performing permission format.

posts.hook: Tres señales de que una amistad te cuida:
posts.draft:
Tres señales de que una amistad te cuida:

1. Se alegra de tus cosas sin compararlas con las suyas.
2. Te pregunta cómo estás y espera la respuesta.
3. Puedes decir que no sin que se rompa nada.

¿Cuál de estas tienes en tu amistad más cercana?
posts.hook_en: Three signs a friendship is looking after you:
posts.draft_en:
Three signs a friendship is looking after you:

1. They're happy for your things without comparing them to theirs.
2. They ask how you are and wait for the answer.
3. You can say no without anything breaking.

Which of these do you have in your closest friendship?
posts.cta: Pregunta: ¿cuál de estas tienes en tu amistad más cercana?
posts.tests: Practical list with a direct question to close
posts.why: A short practical list on friendship gives a clear tip and an easy question to answer.

posts.hook: ¿Te has permitido cambiar de opinión sobre alguien sin sentirte mal por ello?
posts.draft: ¿Te has permitido cambiar de opinión sobre alguien sin sentirte mal por ello? Durante mucho tiempo pensé que cambiar de idea era fallar. Hoy creo que es señal de que te estás escuchando. ¿Te pasó alguna vez?
posts.hook_en: Have you ever allowed yourself to change your mind about someone without feeling bad about it?
posts.draft_en: Have you ever allowed yourself to change your mind about someone without feeling bad about it? For a long time I thought changing my mind meant failing. Today I think it's a sign you're listening to yourself. Has it ever happened to you?
posts.tests: Reflective question at the end of a short personal reflection
posts.why: A hook question with a personal reflection invites replies on ex-related self-doubt.

posts.hook: Lo que hiciste en modo supervivencia no dice quién eres.
posts.draft: Lo que hiciste en modo supervivencia no dice quién eres. Fue lo que te permitió llegar hasta aquí. Tranquila.
posts.hook_en: What you did in survival mode doesn't say who you are.
posts.draft_en: What you did in survival mode doesn't say who you are. It's what got you here. Easy does it.
posts.tests: Validation plus short closing word, without copying the original line
posts.why: A short validating line in the survival-mode frame supports the self-blame relief pillar.

posts.topic: Sé exigente: lo que pide una buena pareja
posts.hook: Sé exigente con estas cuatro cosas:
posts.draft:
Sé exigente con estas cuatro cosas:

- Que sus valores sean parecidos a los tuyos.
- Que te respete cuando no estás delante.
- Que resuelva los conflictos sin castigarte.
- Que cuide tu vulnerabilidad.

¿Cuál es la que más te cuesta pedir?
posts.hook_en: Be demanding about these four things:
posts.draft_en:
Be demanding about these four things:

- That their values are similar to yours.
- That they respect you when you're not there.
- That they resolve conflict without punishing you.
- That they look after your vulnerability.

Which one is hardest for you to ask for?
posts.cta: Pregunta: ¿cuál es la que más te cuesta pedir?
posts.tests: Parallel structure with a closing question
posts.why: A parallel list of what to expect from a partner invites personal replies on healthier relationships.

posts.topic: No necesitas la aprobación de nadie para irte
posts.hook: "No estás obligada a quedarte donde no te cuidan." - Mi frase favorita para una ruptura
posts.draft: "No estás obligada a quedarte donde no te cuidan." Y tampoco necesitas la aprobación de nadie para irte. Puedes irte.
posts.hook_en: "You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for." - My favourite line for a breakup
posts.draft_en: "You are not obliged to stay where you are not cared for." And you don't need anyone's approval to leave. You can leave.
posts.tests: Quote with one line of own reflection, credited
posts.inspiration: @esmipsicologa - quote credited with one own line on top
posts.why: A credited quote with a personal line matches the permission-to-leave theme that drove strong engagement.

posts.hook: Puedes tomar tu café sin prisa y sin compañía.
posts.draft: Puedes tomar tu café sin prisa y sin compañía. Sal a caminar. Esa tarde también es tuya. Tranquila.
posts.hook_en: You can have your coffee without rushing and without company.
posts.draft_en: You can have your coffee without rushing and without company. Go for a walk. That afternoon is yours too. Easy does it.
posts.tests: Short concrete imperatives as a soft morning line
posts.inspiration: @dr.rodrigoarteaga - concrete short imperatives about enjoying your own company
posts.why: Concrete, easy-to-picture imperatives about being alone speak to the friendship-and-self pillar.

posts.hook: Tu tiempo también cuenta. Tres formas de cuidarlo hoy:
posts.draft:
Tu tiempo también cuenta. Tres formas de cuidarlo hoy:

1. Decir que no a un plan que te agota.
2. Dedicar veinte minutos a algo solo tuyo.
3. Dejar de contestar al instante si no te apetece.

¿Cuál vas a probar?
posts.hook_en: Your time matters too. Three ways to look after it today:
posts.draft_en:
Your time matters too. Three ways to look after it today:

1. Say no to a plan that drains you.
2. Spend twenty minutes on something just for you.
3. Stop replying instantly when you don't feel like it.

Which one will you try?
posts.tests: Practical list with a question to close
posts.inspiration: @psico.maxi - warm reassurance plus a concrete closing question
posts.why: A short practical list with a closing question invites replies on time boundaries.

posts.topic: Lo que sí es una buena pareja
posts.hook: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien?
posts.draft: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que te sentiste en paz al lado de alguien? No hablo de una emoción intensa, sino de esa calma en la que puedes ser tú. Piensa en eso un momento.
posts.hook_en: When was the last time you felt at peace next to someone?
posts.draft_en: When was the last time you felt at peace next to someone? I'm not talking about an intense emotion, but that calm where you can just be yourself. Think about it for a moment.
posts.tests: A single short personal question as the main post
posts.inspiration: @enric_corbera - reflective question as the main post
posts.why: A single reflective question about peace in relationships invites personal answers.

posts.hook: Puedes dejar de repasar la conversación del final una y otra vez.
posts.draft: Puedes dejar de repasar la conversación del final una y otra vez. No hay un final mejor que vuelva a reescribirse. Tranquila, ya estás avanzando.
posts.hook_en: You can stop replaying the ending of that conversation over and over.
posts.draft_en: You can stop replaying the ending of that conversation over and over. There's no better ending that will rewrite itself. Easy does it, you're already moving forward.
posts.tests: Soft morning statement on rumination after a breakup
posts.inspiration: @psico.maxi - soft 'vas a ir estando mejor' reassurance
posts.why: A short soft line about ruminating after a breakup gives permission to stop looping.

posts.hook: Señales de que tienes a alguien que te escucha sin juzgar:
posts.draft:
Señales de que tienes a alguien que te escucha sin juzgar:

- Te deja terminar la frase.
- No convierte tu problema en el suyo.
- Te pregunta "¿y tú qué necesitas?".

¿Quién en tu vida cumple alguna de estas?
posts.hook_en: Signs you have someone who listens without judging:
posts.draft_en:
Signs you have someone who listens without judging:

- They let you finish your sentence.
- They don't turn your problem into theirs.
- They ask you "what do you need?"

Who in your life ticks one of these?
posts.cta: Pregunta: ¿quién en tu vida cumple alguna de estas?
posts.tests: Practical signs list plus a question about the reader's own people
posts.why: Concrete signs of a good listener invite readers to name the people who support them.

posts.hook: ¿Qué te dirías hoy si fueras tu mejor amiga?
posts.draft: ¿Qué te dirías hoy si fueras tu mejor amiga? Escríbelo sin filtros, como lo harías con alguien que quieres. Lo mereces.
posts.hook_en: What would you say to yourself today if you were your best friend?
posts.draft_en: What would you say to yourself today if you were your best friend? Write it without filters, the way you would to someone you love. You deserve it.
posts.tests: Reflective question closing a self-compassion week
posts.why: A self-compassion question invites personal reflection and replies at the end of the week.
